title: Advanced Legal 2
completion_message: ¡Veredicto a tu favor! Tienes un dominio del inglés legal que rivaliza con cualquier abogado corporativo de Nueva York. Tu vocabulario es a prueba de demandas.

parts.visual:
Como ejecutivo, interactuarás con abogados constantemente. Conoce su jerga: 

1. Subpoena (Citación judicial): 
- Una orden oficial para asistir a la corte o entregar documentos (se pronuncia 'suh-PEE-nuh'). 
Ej: The CEO received a SUBPOENA to testify before Congress. 

2. Perjury (Perjurio): 
- El crimen de mentir bajo juramento en la corte. 
Ej: He was sentenced to 5 years in prison for PERJURY. 

3. Affidavit (Declaración jurada por escrito): 
- Un documento escrito donde juras que la información es cierta. 
Ej: You must sign this AFFIDAVIT confirming your identity.
parts.audio: Welcome to Advanced Legal English, Part 2. As an executive, you will interact with lawyers constantly. Know their jargon. Number 1: Subpoena. An official order to attend court or surrender documents. Notice the pronunciation: suh-PEE-nuh. For example: The CEO received a SUBPOENA to testify before Congress. Number 2: Perjury. The crime of lying under oath in court. For example: He was sentenced to 5 years in prison for PERJURY. Number 3: Affidavit. A written document in which you swear that the information is true. For example: You must sign this AFFIDAVIT confirming your identity.

parts.visual:
4. Indemnify (Indemnizar / Eximir de responsabilidad): 
- Proteger financieramente a alguien contra futuras pérdidas, o compensar por daño. 
Ej: The contract states that they will INDEMNIFY us against any lawsuits. 

5. Intellectual Property (IP - Propiedad Intelectual): 
- Creaciones de la mente (patentes, marcas, derechos de autor). 
Ej: Our most valuable asset is our INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. 

6. Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA - Acuerdo de confidencialidad): 
- Contrato para no compartir secretos comerciales. 
Ej: Before I show you the prototype, you must sign an NDA. 

7. Severance package (Paquete de indemnización por despido): 
- El dinero y beneficios dados a un empleado cuando es despedido sin causa justificada. 
Ej: When the CEO was fired, he received a $10 million SEVERANCE PACKAGE.
parts.audio: Number 4: Indemnify. To protect someone financially against future losses, or to compensate them for harm or loss. For example: The contract states that they will INDEMNIFY us against any lawsuits. Number 5: Intellectual Property, or IP. Creations of the mind, such as patents, trademarks, and copyrights. For example: Our most valuable asset is our INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. Number 6: Non-Disclosure Agreement, commonly known as an NDA. A legal contract to protect trade secrets. For example: Before I show you the prototype, you must sign an NDA. Finally, Number 7: Severance package. Pay and benefits given to an employee when they are fired or laid off. For example: When the CEO was fired, he received a $10 million SEVERANCE PACKAGE.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término legal corporativo correcto.

questions.question: The judge issued a ____ forcing the company to hand over all its financial records.
Lying to the FBI during an official investigation is a serious crime called ____.
The lawyer asked the witness to write down what he saw and sign an ____ in front of a notary.
The software company agreed to ____ the client, meaning they will pay the legal fees if the client is sued for using the software.
Patents, trademarks, and copyrights are all forms of IP, which stands for Intellectual ____.
I can't tell you what the new iPhone looks like because I signed an ____ (Non-Disclosure Agreement).
When the company laid off 500 workers, it gave them each a ____ package containing 3 months of salary.
A lawyer who represents a client in court during a trial is a ____. (Litigante).
When a company goes bankrupt, the court appoints a ____ to manage the sale of the assets and pay the creditors.
A clause in a contract that frees one party from liability if damages are caused by unpredictable, unavoidable natural disasters is Force ____.
To secretly make illegal copies of a trademarked product and sell it as real is to create ____ goods. (Falsificaciones).
If you use a song in your commercial without permission from the artist, it is copyright ____. (Infracción).
questions.explanation: Copyright infringement = infracción de derechos de autor.

questions.question: When you sign a contract, it is legally ____, meaning you must obey it by law. (Vinculante).
A written rule or law passed by a legislative body is a ____. (Estatuto / Ley).
To start legal action against someone is to ____ them. (Demandar).
The person or company that is being sued or accused in court is the ____. (Acusado / Demandado).
The person who brings a case against another in a court of law is the ____. (Demandante).
To drop a lawsuit because the two sides agreed on a private payment is to ____ out of court.
questions.explanation: Settle out of court = llegar a un acuerdo extrajudicial.

questions.question: An amount of money paid to a victim to punish the defendant and deter future bad behavior is ____ damages. (Daños punitivos).
If you fail to do what the contract requires, you are in ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: A court ____. (Citación judicial con S)
Guilty of ____. (Perjurio/Mentir al juez con P)
Sign this ____. (Declaración jurada con A)
We will ____ you. (Indemnizar/proteger con I)
Intellectual ____. (Propiedad intelectual con P)
Sign an ____. (Acuerdo de confidencialidad de 3 letras)
A ____ package. (Paquete de cesantía/despido con S)
Force ____. (Fuerza mayor con M)
____ goods. (Bienes falsificados con C)
Copyright ____. (Infracción de derechos con I)
